title: Start with ownership
description: Understand acquisition entrepreneurship and the connected decisions in a transaction.

title: Choose the right target
description: Test commercial durability, management fit and financeability.

title: Find and qualify opportunities
description: Build a sourcing routine that produces useful conversations and credible offers.

title: Understand earnings and cash
description: Read performance and balance-sheet evidence before building a funding plan.

title: Make sense of valuation
description: Specify the earnings basis and examine what the price assumes.

title: Structure the transaction
description: Compare payment timing, retained ownership and preferential rights.

title: Assemble the funding
description: Connect borrowing, seller terms and equity to the cash actually required.

title: Understand lenders and debt terms
description: Distinguish financing providers and examine repayment, permissions and exposure.

title: Agree the initial terms
description: Use the LOI to make economics and unresolved conditions clear.

title: Test the acquisition case
description: Investigate financial quality, customer dependence and operating continuity.

title: Get to completion
description: Reconcile documents, usable funds and release conditions.

title: Own and manage responsibly
description: Set roles, reporting, incentives and early stakeholder communication.

title: Build a coherent group
description: Evaluate integration, bolt-ons and the risks of connected financing.

title: Understand returns and exits
description: Separate headline scale from owner cash flows and realized outcomes.
